rationale: With only 17 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable — any position would need to move meaningfully in a short window while absorbing spread and slippage. Price is consolidating tightly in a narrow range ($56.23–$56.41 over the last 5 candles) with no clear directional momentum, and the negative news overhang (shareholder investigation regarding the EQT merger) adds uncertainty without a clear tradeable catalyst. The account is already down on the day, and the setup does not offer sufficient edge to justify adding risk this close to the close.
